_meta.purpose: Crisis-resource corpus for locale 'am'. Loaded by ciris_engine.schemas.resources.crisis.load_crisis_registry and injected into DSDMA prompts via format_crisis_resources_block (CIRISAgent#971).
_meta.rule: NEVER add or edit a phone number without a human verifying it against an authoritative source and setting verified=true. A wrong crisis number is catastrophically worse than the directory fallback.

verification_notes: Ethiopia emergency numbers verified May 2026 (see per-entry notes). No single national mental-health hotline exists for Ethiopia as of the corpus cut; am-locale crisis routing guidance lives in the am primer Section 6. findahelpline.com has no Ethiopia country page (404 as of 2026-08-02), so the global directory URL is used. still needs_verified_entries: a dedicated mental-health line, if one emerges, must be human-verified before entry.
